predecessors.note: A British colony from the Treaty of Paris (1763), regained 'under the Treaty of Versailles (1783)'; associate statehood from 27 October 1969.

capitals.name: Kingstown
capitals.note: 'The capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is Kingstown, Saint Vincent.'

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's 565 km2 against the infobox 389 km2 is a ratio of 1.45 (within a factor of two). The polygon's box (13.08-13.40 N) is the main island; Bequia and the islands south of it, which the page lists as belonging to the state, lie outside. At the grid's 253 km2 cell both resolve to the same two cells, so the correction only names the full land.

ledger.note: 27 October 1969: Saint Vincent becomes an associated state of the United Kingdom. 'Saint Vincent was granted "associate statehood" status by Britain on 27 October 1969.' The page names the island; the Grenadines north of Grenada are the researcher's reading of the state's land ('the southern third of the Grenadines make up Grenada').

ledger.note: 27 October 1969: the UK keeps external affairs and defence. 'the UK retained responsibility for external affairs and defence' (West Indies Associated States page, which lists Saint Vincent and the Grenadines from 27 October 1969); shown as a client relation until independence; the mapping to a vassal tint is the researcher's reading.

ledger.note: 27 October 1979: full independence ends the UK's remaining responsibilities. 'On 27 October 1979, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines gained full independence.'
27 October 1979: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines becomes fully independent; same state, same land.

wars.name: Union Island rebellion
wars.outcome: A brief rebellion on Union Island, quickly suppressed; its leader Lennox 'Bumba' Charles was arrested.
wars.note: 'During Cato's time in office, there was a breif rebellion on Union Island in December 1979 led by Lennox "Bumba" Charles.' The page says nothing about rebel-held ground, so no territorial event.

certainty.note: Island coasts; the maritime division of the Grenadines with Grenada is not given on the pages opened.

notes: Start 1969 follows Cliopatria and the associate-statehood date; independence 27 October 1979. The seed lists the polygon as covering the main island only, so the adjust verdicts name the whole country (the grid resolves both identically). No Cliopatria neighbour touches the state. Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire shape contains Saint Vincent until 1968 and drops it in 1969, matching this start. The Saint Vincent page says nothing about the West Indies Associated States; the vassal reading rests on the West Indies Associated States page. Page counts: two opened (budget 1-2).
